relations.rationale: Spectators lining the roads has no bearing on scheduling of future events.
Pia finishing ahead of Zeno doesn't determine anything about Zeno vs Vik's relative finish.
Pia finishing ahead of Zeno says nothing directly about Vik finishing ahead of Pia.
Alma arriving earliest of everyone that morning supports the claim that she arrived long before sunrise.
Alma's early arrival that morning is unrelated to the finishing order between Zeno and Vik.
Alma arriving earliest that morning is consistent with but doesn't determine her staying near the finish later, as these are different time points/events.
Alma's early arrival has no bearing on scheduling of the next regional event.
Alma's early arrival time has no logical connection to age comparisons between Vik and Alma.
Vik being younger than Tess doesn't establish anything about Vik's age relative to Alma.
Vik's age relative to Tess is unrelated to claims about training rigor.
Vik's age compared to Tess has no bearing on Zeno's nodding.
Vik being younger than Alma doesn't imply anything about training rigor comparisons.
Vik's age relative to Alma is unrelated to reach comparisons between Tess and Pia.
Training rigor of riders is unrelated to the difficulty of the final descent.
Vik's training rigor compared to others has no bearing on Alma's post-race socializing.
Zeno finishing ahead of Vik contradicts Vik finishing ahead of Pia only if Pia and Zeno's order matters, but by itself Zeno beating Vik doesn't affect Vik vs Pia.
The finishing order between Zeno and Vik has no bearing on Alma's post-race behavior.
The weather staying clear throughout the event supports the idea that organizers viewed the clear weather as fortunate given a poor forecast.
Organizers' view on weather luck is unrelated to Alma's chatting with volunteers.
The organizers' comments about weather luck have no bearing on scheduling of the next event.
